run_docstring_helpfulness_evaluation: run the docstring helpfulness evaluation on sampled components using an LLM model
sample_valid_components: sample code components where all systems have valid docstrings for evaluation
evaluate_single_component: evaluate docstrings from all systems for a given code component across aspects
calculate_evaluation_statistics: calculate average scores by system, aspect, and their combinations from results
format_statistics_markdown: format evaluation statistics as a markdown report with tables for each breakdown
